scope: First full-period wave of the existing twenty-model plan; no return-based model selection
selection_reason: Cached models with completed v7 accounting, including all three failed v9 pilot models; family coverage and ready transport, not expected return
budget: 8 responses, 1024 output tokens per response, same in both arms
completion_rule: All 88 dated decisions plus receipt and independent cash/unit accounting per seed; all three seeds per completed model
failure_rule: Invalid decisions stay in the ledger with unchanged units; infrastructure failure leaves an incomplete pair, never a fabricated zero return
comparison_limit: Development path and retrospective source-availability assumptions; this is not a causal before/after estimate of a single repair
